::: {#exr-naive-softmax}

#### Softmax straight from its formula

A trained network can be confident,
with [logits](#def-logits) in the hundreds.
Take `z` to be the first test image's logits from @exm-logits times 1,000.
What goes wrong when the softmax of `z` is computed with its formula,
`torch.exp(z) / torch.exp(z).sum()`?

:::
